title: Notice on Postponed Meeting of ‘Expert working group along with Stakeholders -Veterinary Biologicals’ on 23rdMarch 2020 and ‘Expert working group along with Stakeholders Veterinary pharmaceuticals’ on 24th March 2020 at IPC, Ghaziabad
bodyHtml: Due to Coronavirus outbreak and to prevent its spread the Meeting of ‘Expert working group along with Stakeholders -Veterinary Biologicals’ and ‘Expert working group along with Stakeholders -Veterinary pharmaceuticals’ scheduled on 23rd March 2020 and 24th March 2020 respectively at IPC, Ghaziabad has been postponed till further information.
